ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) surface area with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixel coverage primarily located in linear and punctate patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark base pigmentation across both lobes. High-contrast white focal points and linear streaks are distributed irregularly, with a higher concentration of punctate white markers near the medial-inferior region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-vertex angle of 50-60 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending to the peduncle interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranges from 3 to 12 pixels, most pronounced on the distal portions of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave trailing edges transitioning into sharp convex upward curves at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse white punctate clusters (approximately 2-5 pixels in diameter) consistent with historic barnacle attachment points, scattered across the central surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast, non-parallel white linear streaks (rake marks) varying in length from 20 to 80 pixels, oriented primarily along the vertical and diagonal axes of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive network of linear rake marks and minor necrotic or scarred pitting on the ventral surface; distinct irregular chips visible along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, deep irregular notch located on the superior trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately 30% inward from the distal tip.
